rawContent: And, frankly, that's okay. It's not time for me to share my story--whether it's my #meat14 story or my #metoo story. It's not time yet. And *that is okay.*

@purekatherine THAT. I think it's a storyline that even Dick Wolf couldn't come up with on his own. I don't think they've addressed the #metoo situation at all this season and I think this would be the best one to go with.
